chapters.title: Overview of GL account deletion risks
Check GL account deletion after field
Block deletion of GL account setting

features.name: Check GL account usage setting
features.description: Blocks any attempt to delete a GL account if the account is used in any setup tables, such as posting setup.

features.name: Check GL account deletion after field
features.description: Allows specification of a date after which GL account deletions with transactions cannot occur, supporting regulatory data retention requirements.
caveats: Works in combination with block deletion of GL account setting

features.name: Block deletion of GL account setting
features.description: Outright blocks the deletion of GL accounts when combined with the check GL account deletion after field to enforce mandatory retention periods.
caveats: Must be used in combination with check GL account deletion after field

quotes.text: We recommend that you change some settings to restrict when these deletions can occur. This is done on the general ledger setup page.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the primary recommendation and location for implementing GL account deletion safeguards.

quotes.text: With the check GL account usage setting we can block any attempt to delete a GL account if the account is used in any
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the first protection mechanism that prevents deletion of accounts used in configuration.

quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates how to translate regulatory requirements into specific date-based deletion controls.

quotes.text: I set the check GL account deletion after to December 31st, 2017. This means I can only delete the account if transactions has happened

quotes.text: If I want to outright block the deletion of the account, I'll have to use the third setting called block deletion of GL account.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the most restrictive option for completely preventing GL account deletions.
